name: Skuerto
summary: At Refuge Pointe, Skuerto scouts the dangerous Arathi Highlands for the Alliance. Archmage Malin sent him with Apprentice Kryten to gather arcane reagents and recover artifacts once owned by Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane.

sections.title: A Scout in the Highlands
sections.body: Skuerto scouts the dangerous Arathi Highlands for the Alliance. The Ironforge dwarf is stationed at Refuge Pointe with Apprentice Kryten. Archmage Malin directs their search for arcane reagents and powerful artifacts once owned by his old master, Archmage Trelane.

sections.title: Pride and Peril
sections.body: Skuerto takes pride in scouting the harsh Highlands and bristles when anyone questions his skill. His work brings him near the region's dangers: the hostile Syndicate, Boulderfist ogres, and ancient entities bound to the land.

faq.q: Why is Skuerto stationed in Arathi instead of Ironforge?
faq.answer: Archmage Malin sent Skuerto to Refuge Pointe with Apprentice Kryten. They gather reagents and recover items left behind by Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane, who fled Stromgarde when it fell under siege.

faq.q: What is Skuerto's mission at Refuge Pointe?
faq.answer: Skuerto and Apprentice Kryten gather arcane reagents and recover powerful magical artifacts once owned by Archmage Trelane, Malin's former master.

faq.q: Who are Skuerto's allies in the region?
faq.answer: Skuerto works with Apprentice Kryten, his partner in Archmage Malin's work, and with the Alliance defenders holding Refuge Pointe.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Skuerto shows the grit of those serving the Alliance on its wild frontiers. His scout's pride is easily bruised.
